title: Measurement Performance Domain
coreMove: Use measurement to guide action, not decorate status: compare KPIs with baselines, read forecasts with context, and connect every dashboard signal to a decision.

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads learning the domain map
exampleSpecs.stakes: a green dashboard may be read apart from the other domains
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people use the 8 domains to keep a KPI tied to action.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a green status pack could hide weak value delivery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A green KPI set looks safe until adoption evidence breaks the expectation.

exampleSpecs.stakes: green release status could silence a defect trend
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A short chat shows that KPIs and baselines still need interpretation.

exampleSpecs.stakes: routine reporting could copy colors without asking what action follows
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A routine gets interrupted so the analyst restarts with a decision threshold.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a defect chart could be read outside team load and delivery notes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small desk moment shows a measure placed inside the PMBOK Guide domain map.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a failed handoff exposed status measures that never triggered action
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The postmortem opens after failure and locates the missed measurement decision.
